verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, candimasūriyānaṁ upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four corruptions obscure the sun and moon, so they don’t shine and glow and radiate.

verses.pali: Abbhā, bhikkhave, candimasūriyānaṁ upakkilesā, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
Mahikā, bhikkhave, candimasūriyānaṁ upakkilesā, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
Dhūmo rajo, bhikkhave, candimasūriyānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
Rāhu, bhikkhave, asurindo candimasūriyānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: An eclipse of Rāhu, lord of titans …

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro candimasūriyānaṁ upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasūriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: These are four corruptions that obscure the sun and moon, so they don’t shine and glow and radiate.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattārome samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: In the same way, these four things corrupt ascetics and brahmins, so they don’t shine and glow and radiate.

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṁ pivanti merayaṁ, surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā.
verses.english: There are some ascetics and brahmins who drink beer and wine, not refraining from drinking beer and wine.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: This is the first thing that corrupts ascetics and brahmins …

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṁ dhammaṁ paṭisevanti, methunasmā dhammā appaṭiviratā.
verses.english: There are some ascetics and brahmins who have sex, not refraining from sex.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: This is the second thing that corrupts ascetics and brahmins …

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṁ sādiyanti, jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā.
verses.english: There are some ascetics and brahmins who accept gold and currency, not refraining from receiving gold and currency.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: This is the third thing that corrupts ascetics and brahmins …

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvanti, micchājīvā appaṭiviratā.
verses.english: There are some ascetics and brahmins who make a living the wrong way, not refraining from wrong livelihood.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ, bhikkhave, catuttho samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
verses.english: This is the fourth thing that corrupts ascetics and brahmins …

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocantīti.
verses.english: These are four things that corrupt ascetics and brahmins, so they don’t shine and glow and radiate.
are plagued by greed and hate;
make a living the wrong way.
by the Buddha, Kinsman of the Sun.
bondservants of craving, full of attachments,
swell the horrors of the charnel ground,
